notes: Note the shift from the present tense 'καταλαβαίνω' to the future/aorist 'καταλάβω'—the stem changes internally.
Do not confuse this with 'μαθαίνω' (to learn); 'καταλαβαίνω' is about the internal lightbulb moment of processing information, whereas 'μαθαίνω' is about the process of acquiring knowledge.
